notes:
Thank you for updating the Cube Solver App! New Custom Cube feature is now available:
You can customize the pattern of each cube tile with two modes: Puzzle and Match.
Puzzle Mode: All tiles on the same face are split pieces of an image.
Match Mode: All tiles on the same face use the same image.
It supports magic cubes of all orders, and provides formulas for solving.

Wish you a smooth and pleasant experience!
